state.title: Zero Emission Vehicle (ZEV) and Plug-In Hybrid Electric Vehicle (PHEV) Rebates
state.sum: The Driving Rhode Island to Vehicle Electrification (DRIVE EV) rebate program offers rebates for the purchase or lease of ZEVs and PHEVs. Rebate amounts vary based on vehicle type: Vehicle Technology Maximum Rebate Amount ZEV $1,500 for a new vehicle; $1,000 for a pre-owned vehicle PHEV $1,000 for a new vehicle;

laws.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charger Make-Ready Requirements
laws.sum: Beginning Jan. 1, 2024, all new parking lots—and existing lots that add 50% or more spaces—must designate parking spaces for EVs.

laws.title: Residential Electric Vehicle (EV) Charger Standard
laws.sum: Beginning Jan. 1, 2023, EV chargers sold, leased, or rented in Rhode Island must be ENERGY STAR® certified. For more information, see the ENERGY STAR EV Chargers website.
